other_conditions: Must be a Scheduled Caste girl resident of Gujarat
For Diploma level courses, the student must have scored at least 50% percentile in the examination of Std 10 or 12
For Graduate level courses, the student must have scored at least 50% percentile in the examination of Std 12
Applicants must fulfil all conditions of the Government of India's Post Matric Scholarship Scheme Guidelines
Income must be more than 2.50 lakh
benefits_summary: Provides academic allowance ranging from ₹4,000 to ₹13,500 for hostellers and day scholars, covering tuition and other fees, with additional disability allowance for disabled students.
